name: seeded-scatter
title: Seeded random scatter
summary: Two hundred dots whose positions and sizes come from rand() reseeded per dot with seed(n, rand()), so every render and every player draws the same scatter.
prompt: Scatter 200 random dots of different sizes that look the same every time it renders.
teaches: Make random values reproducible with seed(s, rand()): it seeds the generator with s, then evaluates rand()
Give each dot and each coordinate its own seed (1 + i, 1001 + i, 2001 + i) so the result does not depend on evaluation order
Scale rand()'s 0..1 output into a range: 10 + 340 × rand
Spread seeded positions over componentWidth() - 20 by componentHeight() - 20 so the scatter fills any box
pitfalls: A bare rand() draws from the shared generator, so its values depend on what else has drawn from it and on evaluation order; seed inside each expression for a stable picture
seed(0, …) means reseed from the clock, i.e. not deterministic

snippets.note: cx, cy and radius each from seed(k + i, rand())

check.describe: 200 dots of 1.5–5 dp scattered over the canvas, teal to violet left to right; two renders are pixel-identical. Resized, the same 200 seeded dots spread over the whole box (positions are fractions of componentWidth()/componentHeight()).
